_readme: Every rule and rate of the site lives here, each with its source key (RECETTE §4). Auction data (ssb.json, tbills.json, sora.json) comes from the MAS API through scripts/update-data.mjs, not from this file. Values read on the pages cited, on retrieved_at.

ssb.opens: 6pm on the 1st business day of the month
ssb.closes: 9pm on the 4th last business day of the month
ssb.results: 3rd last business day of the month
ssb.redemptionPaid: second business day of the next month

tbill.cpfNote: OA money can be invested only above the first S$20,000 kept in the OA (CPF Board). Agent bank charges vary by bank and are not counted here; enter them by lowering the yield if your bank charges.
tbill.auctionTiming: Auctions typically take place 3 business days before issuance and are announced on the SGS website 5 business days before the auction
tbill.feeNote: MAS pages do not state a bank fee for T-bill applications; the calculations count none. If your bank charges one, the yield you keep is lower by that amount.

life.note: CPF Board estimate for members turning 55 in 2026, payouts from 65, at 4% interest

deposit.note: Default rates are read from src/data/deposits.json (MAS MSB table III.3A), not from here
